rules.effective_date_basis: Interest shall begin accruing on November 1, 1990, on a monthly basis.
rules.title: Security deposit interest requirement for LARSO properties
rules.requirement: Landlords of City of Los Angeles properties subject to LARSO must pay tenants interest on security deposits either monthly or annually. The landlord must choose direct payment or rent credit and notify the tenant in writing of that choice.

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies to properties located within the City of Los Angeles that are subject to the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (LARSO).
coverage.summary: Covers City of Los Angeles rental properties subject to LARSO.

rules.penalty: The document states that non-compliance has been used as a defense in eviction proceedings and that failure to comply can result in loss of eviction cases and other legal complications.
rules.interaction: The document describes the security-deposit-interest duty as applying to landlords of properties subject to the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: Interest shall begin accruing on November 1, 1990, on a monthly basis. A tenant shall be given the unpaid accrued interest in the form of either a direct payment or a credit against the tenant’s rent. The landlord shall choose between these two methods of payment and notify the tenant in writing of his or her choice.
